content: The theme for World Neglected Tropical Disease (NTD) Day in 2024 is Unite Act Eliminate, emphasizing the importance of collaboration, proactive measures, and eradication efforts to combat these diseases. For over 20 years, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has been actively engaged in efforts to reduce the burden of illness, disability, and mortality caused by neglected tropical diseases. Various partner organizations are working alongside the CDC to eliminate neglected tropical diseases, and numerous resources are available to support these efforts. Publications from the World Health Organization (WHO) and other authoritative sources provide valuable insights and updates on neglected tropical diseases. A comprehensive fact sheet on neglected tropical diseases is available, offering detailed information about these conditions and the global efforts to address them.
